1;if($tz){$startTemp=($tz.CurrentTemperature/10)-273.15}}catch{};$cores=(Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor).NumberOfLogicalProcessors;if(-not $cores -or $cores -lt 5|Out-Null;$jobs|Remove-Job -Force;$endTime=Get-Date;$actualDuration=[math]::Round(($endTime-$startTime).TotalSeconds);$avgLoad=if($cpuSamples.Count -gt 0){[math]::Round(($cpuSamples|Measure-Object const r = items[0].json; const rows = r.diagnostics.map(d => ` ${d.category} ${d.status} ${d.summary} `).join(''); const html = `

CheckTop Laptop Health Report

Verdict: ${r.verdict}

${r.buyer_summary.summary}

${rows}
Category Status Summary

Recommended Price: $${r.pricing.recommended_price_usd}

Confidence: ${r.diagnostic_confidence.confidence_percent}%

`; return [{ json: { html } }];
